name: Seed
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the earth to bring forth plants bearing seed according to their kinds, establishing a natural order where every herb, tree, and grass yields its own seed (Genesis 1:11-12, 29). This divine design underscores the principle of seedtime and harvest as a continuing, God-ordained cycle while the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). Additionally, the concept of seed carries spiritual significance, as seen in the enmity between the seed of the woman and the seed of the serpent, pointing forward to redemption (Genesis 3:15).
